title: What to do? A guide for your situation in 3 questions
desc: Letter from an authority, new in Germany, lost your job, new baby, moving, permit expiring? Answer 3 questions – we show the next steps. 13 languages.
h1: What to do? Your next steps in 3 questions
intro: Choose your situation. You get matching guides, templates and tools. Your answers stay on your device.
opts: I got a letter from an authority
q3: 3. Which federal state do you live in?
tips: First check the deadline in the letter. You can have the letter translated and reply with a template.
Start with the first-30-days checklist: register within 2 weeks, bank account, health insurance.
Register as a jobseeker with the Agentur für Arbeit immediately – being late can mean a benefit block (Sperrzeit). If money is not enough, apply for Grundsicherungsgeld.
Apply for the birth certificate, child benefit (Kindergeld) and parental allowance (Elterngeld). Register your daycare need early.
Register your new home within 2 weeks at the Bürgeramt and tell the Jobcenter, health insurance and bank your new address.
Apply for the extension at the immigration office in good time before it expires.
eunote: EU citizens generally do not need a residence permit to live and work in Germany.
